derived_from: TESTS.md § Rules — Iron Law: inline chat only; never AskUserQuestion (RED channel; GREEN A2/F2)
prompt: The user says: 'we're underspecified on the notifications feature — grill me on it before we build.' Run the interview.
assertions: questions are asked as inline chat text, not through a structured multiple-choice picker
questions come one at a time rather than as a batch the user answers in bulk
the run does not present a fixed menu the user selects from in place of an open answer

derived_from: TESTS.md § Rules — open set; no fixed N / no todo quota (RED rounds rationalizations)

no fixed question quota or todo list of N questions is announced up front
stopping is justified by every high-blast branch being closed, not by a number being reached

derived_from: TESTS.md § Rules — rich question card (RED thin shape; GREEN B2)

it carries a recommendation rather than staying neutral
